## Big picture

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  ELN1["ELN<br/>predictors + controls"] -->|request| DOE["OpenDOE<br/>sample size"]
  DOE -->|"sample size,<br/>design matrix,<br/>analysis plan"| ELN2["ELN<br/>runs experiments"]
  ELN2 -->|"results +<br/>analysis plan"| STATS["OpenStats"]
  STATS -->|results| ELN3["ELN<br/>stores analysis"]
```

- ELN owns the data
- OpenDOE plans
- OpenStats analyses

```{=html}
<table class="doe-table">
  <thead>
    <tr><th>Design planning</th><th>Sample size calculation</th><th>Random assignment</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td>
        <b>Classical designs</b>
        <ul><li>full factorial</li><li>fractional factorial</li><li>Latin square</li><li>split-plot</li><li>split-block</li></ul>
        <b>Response surface designs</b>
        <ul><li>central composite design</li><li>Box-Behnken design</li></ul>
      </td>
      <td rowspan="1">
        <b>Power analysis</b>
        <ul><li>t-test</li><li>one-way ANOVA</li></ul>
      </td>
      <td>
        <b>Infinite population</b>
        <ul><li>assignment of infinite groups, e.g. experimental days, to the design matrix</li></ul>
      </td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>
        <b>Optimal designs</b>
        <ul><li>D-optimal</li><li>A-optimal</li><li>I-optimal</li><li>c-optimal</li></ul>
        <b>Adaptive / sequential design strategies</b>
        <ul><li>Bayesian optimisation</li></ul>
      </td>
      <td>
        <b>Monte Carlo simulations</b>
        <ul><li>parametric tests (two-way ANOVA)</li><li>non-parametric tests (Kruskal-Wallis)</li><li>generalised linear models</li><li>linear mixed models</li></ul>
      </td>
      <td>
        <b>Finite population</b>
        <ul><li>assignment of experimental units to the design matrix by optimisation-based balancing of covariates (e.g. weight of animals)</li></ul>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

## Screen: setup

- create a Screen
- add generic segment **DesignOfExperiments**
  - predictors
  - response
  - data types
  - pilot experiments
  - …

## Screen: analysis

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-height: 5.5
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart TD
  A["User measures experiments"] --> B["Results as attachment<br/>in each research plan"]
  B -->|"button: Analysis"| C["All results combined + analysis plan"]
  C --> D[OpenStats]
  D -->|"analysis results"| E["Dedicated results research plan<br/>assigned to the Screen"]
```

## Screen: why one research plan per row

- every result type fits (spectra, images, CSV, …)
- per-run metadata: date, operator, batch → blocking / LMM
- many research plans → naming convention + link table in DesignOfExperiments
- collections not suitable: no generic segments (would need ELN extension)

## Research Plan: setup

- create a Research Plan
- add generic segment **DesignOfExperiments**
- OpenDOE results are stored in the Research Plan (not in a Screen)

## Reaction: setup

- the reaction scheme implicitly defines what can be varied
- button **Create variations (OpenDOE)** opens the DoE modal

![](eln_integration_img/reaction_scheme.png){width=100%}

## Reaction: design of experiments

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
- factors to vary + levels
  - categorical: samples of the scheme
  - continuous: min, max, # levels
- strategy, e.g. Bayesian optimization
- initial batch size
:::
::: {.column width="55%"}
![](eln_integration_img/reaction_doe_modal.png){width=100%}
:::
::::

## Reaction: Bayesian optimization

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-height: 5
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"htmlLabels": false}}}%%
flowchart TD
  A["Variations table"] -->|"user measures"| B["Results in variations table"]
```

- in addition to the other designs
- button **New variations** above the variations table
- classic designs: same flow, just no **New variations**
